$comment: G26 light-template guard allow-list (docs/design/unicorn-template.md v2 § 6). Each entry: file = path relative to src/ (exact, a prefix ending in '/', or '*' for any file); rule = which guard rule it excuses (omit for all); pattern = RegExp source tested against the offending LINE; reason = why this dark/white/raw colour is legitimate. Keep ≤ 30 entries; every entry must still match at least one hit or the guard fails (stale entries are removed, not kept). The guard has enforced by default since G26-X (2026-09-21): a hit outside this list fails CI.

entries.reason: white label on a saturated brand / semantic fill on the same line — a primary button, chip, badge or step dot. The fill itself is still checked by dark-surface where it is a band.
modal / drawer scrim (40–80 % black over the page) — not a surface.
code sample blocks keep an editor-dark ground (mono text on ink-900) — a recognised convention, not page chrome.
the Logo's variant="dark" wordmark — graphic-only, for the rare caller that still places the mark on a navy fill (OG images, e-mail headers).
